purpose: Repair the confirmed exact-main activation and deployment EXIT-trap scope failure, make rollback outcomes explicit, and publish redacted failure evidence without exposing model credentials or widening production authority.
requiredBehavior: keep activation and deployment EXIT-trap state outside function-local scope
attempt rollback only after the corresponding mutation boundary begins
treat rollback failure as a distinct terminal failure
publish only redacted structured failure evidence to runner-output
reuse the already validated model token from the single active API container
never require or transmit a private model-host SSH key through GitHub Actions
preserve exact-main, root-only controller and non-root runner authority
forbiddenCapabilities: secret values in logs or artifacts
private SSH key transport through GitHub Actions or repository secrets
